PaintFE 1.4.4

A few improvements to Colors, saving and command-line use.

- Colors controls now fit smaller panels, with hex editing and copying available through a popup when space is tight.
- Save As remembers your export format for opened images too.
- Images opened by drag-and-drop now keep their original folder for Save As.
- Fixed garbled non-English command-line text on Windows and preserved redirected output and errors.

Clippy passed. The full test suite finished with 425 passed, 0 failed and 5 existing ignored tests.
